The Sect Leader left the sect for love, while the Martial Uncle fell into demonic cultivation for the woman he loved…
Neither immortal nor heroic, just handsome men and beautiful women playing house.
Only the Little Junior Brother is reliable, upholding the sect while dedicating himself to profound cultivation.

Losing her former glory? It doesn’t matter—no one can compete with her voice as a beautiful singer.
Mocked by her lowly birth? It doesn’t matter—her true identity is enough to make the whole world tremble.
She owes huge debts? It doesn’t matter...
A powerful boss once whispered to her, “Your debt will disappear if you become my woman.”
But the proud her would reply, “I’m sorry. I would sell my art, but not myself.”

alter-dimension-lucky-dungeon-master:
Alex, a young man with ambition but unfortunate life.
He grew up as an orphan and from a very young age, learned to stand on his own feet.
Barely making a living by searching through the dumpsite for things that could be sold.
One day, when he came back home from the dumpsite, Alex decided to rest on the new sofa that he got from the dumpsite just the other day.
But unexpectedly something magical happened to him.
A stone inlaid on the sofa suddenly brought him to an alternate dimension!
And there, Alex rise started, controlling the luck of the world.
Everything runs through his favor.
Whenever a problem comes up, it gets solve unknowingly.
When he lacks money, gold suddenly fell down from the sky.
Opening a treasure chest will always give great rewards.
Lottery is nonsense, he will win no matter what.
When a strong monster is about to kill him, it will trip on a rock and have its head explode, dying by itself.
That's how against the sky he is!
From then on, Alex became known as 'Fortune', the one who controls luck!
apocalypse-every-woman-i-invest-in-makes:
Ethan Carter died a completely useless death.
After weeks of surviving the early chaos, he finally got a moment alone with his girlfriend. They had never gone all the way. That night was supposed to be the first time. She was already on top of him when her military father kicked the door open and put a bullet through his head.
He didn’t even get to finish.
When Ethan opens his eyes again, he is no longer in his own body. He has transmigrated into a parallel world already one month into the apocalypse, trapped in the broken body of a man who died being a complete simp. A mysterious red fog has turned half of humanity into mindless zombies. Mutated beasts roam the ruins. Civilization is gone.
Then the system activates.
The Doomsday Gift System.
Every time Ethan gifts supplies to a high Beauty Score woman, the system multiplies the return by 50x, 70x, even 200x, and rewards him with powerful abilities, expanded storage space, and combat skills. The higher her Beauty Score and the stronger her emotional reaction, the greater the reward.
One gift. One woman. One massive return.…
apocalyptic-wasteland-simulator:
In the year 1257 of the Federation Calendar, Chen Pingchuan, who has crossed into a different world for three years, gets the Apocalyptic Wasteland Simulator.
Through information obtained from the simulator, a sudden disaster will strike Spring City in a year. Accompanied by highly radioactive red rain, a type of mutated creature called Black Demon will be born.
With the simulator, Chen is in a better position to survive, but he also wants to find out the secrets of the girl he meets in simulations.
Simulator: [She left you a small bottle of liquid with an unknown effect and a note with just two short lines written on it.]
[Avoid the red rain!]
[Forget me!]
ascension-of-the-nephilim:
Kyros Steele was the strongest warrior in the Omega Kingdom. But when the Great War of All began, this kingdom fell. Kyros was captured.
Destined to become a slave through necromancy, Kyros could only curse at his led bitter life.
But on his final moments, he meets an eccentric Old Man who claimed to be the God of Time.
Much like Kyros, this Old Man was fated for suffering and defeat. Because the God of Time could not be killed, the Great Gods conspired to curse him and make him human first. And so the God of Time escaped but was now human. Even if he used his powerful magic to send his consciousness back in time, he would still be defeated, for his soul was no longer a god but a man.
Helpless as his time-traveling rebirth would easily fail, the God of Time offers and asks for Kyros's help. He would send Kyros back along with his own consciousness back in time. This would hide the God of Time from his enemies and give Kyros the chance to fulfill his revenge.
Just when the two were about to time travel, a shocking mystery caused the God of Time to marvel in awe. Kyros was not a human but had the bloodline of the most accursed and dangerous race of all.…
baka-to-test-to-shoukanjuu:
The protagonist is a guy who is among the stupidest of the stupidest in the school. In this school, your grades can, under the supervision of teachers, take a virtual form to do combat! However, if you leave an examination half way, you get zero marks. A bright and cute girl, Mizuki Himeji, was having a high fever during the examination. Despite her potential to be the second highest scorer in the level, she obtained zero marks for having left due to her illness and is thus allocated to the worst class, class F.
Grades mean almost everything. For Class A, they have a smart-looking teacher, a plasma TV as big as the entire wall as their blackboard, personal laptops, personal air-cons, refrigerators, adjustable seats and all kinds of different appliances. Within the refrigerator, there are all kinds of drinks and snacks. Their ceiling is made of glass, the wall lets them put up high-class drawings and plants.
As for Class F, the worst class… They have Japanese desks and seat paddings.…

beacon-of-light-in-the-dark-sea:
Inside the 3000m underwater station, an international group of scientists and engineers live and research for possible settlement of entire human race. Park Mu-hyun, a reserved dentist joins the station in hopes for a quaint life in the deep sea. However, things quickly go south when the station gets attacked by a mysterious group of people.
As the water starts to fill in the living quarters, Park Mu-hyun grabs his backpack and immediately runs for his life, but where to? Now, the peaceful station becomes the ultimate survival stage of cult madness and chaos.
blhunted-by-the-god-of-destruction:
He was supposed to live a quiet life.
Elias Clarke is a recessive omega… technically. His heats are rare, his hormones are mild, and his genetic profile is so muted that he could pass for beta. That’s fine with him. At 27, he is halfway through his PhD, teaches engineering part-time, and enjoys the kind of anonymity that keeps him away from the political games of those born with true divine potential.
But when his best friend and roommate, Ruoxi Numen, disappears without a trace, Elias becomes the only one asking questions no one wants to answer.
Her family, descended from the last god born three hundred years ago, calls it a “private matter.”
Her apartment remains untouched, with her jewelry, tablet, and expensive shoes near the door.
Then Victor Numen, her older brother who was crippled in a divine accident, reappears in public. Smiling. Watching Elias too closely.
Something happened to Ruoxi.
And Elias might be the only person who can figure out what.
bloodline-evolution-i-can-choose-opposin:
On the day known as the Great Awakening, the barrier separating mortals, spirits, and gods shattered without warning. Divine influence poured into the world like rain and the world was forever changed.
Aren Cross stood at the very top of that new world, one of the strongest Mystics to ever live.
For that strength, he was betrayed. In his final moments, Aren attempted to evolve once more, to abandon humanity and ascend as a god. He failed.
But, instead of death, Aren awakens in his high school classroom, moments before his first bloodline awakening ceremony.
This time, with knowledge of the future, he will choose the strongest Evolutions.
Water and Fire are opposing elements? Why not pick both?
Wings or Burrowing Traits? Let me take them all.
book-of-the-dead:
With one touch of the stone, Tyron receives his Class and his life changes forever.
In an instant his bright and promising future as the scion of two powerful Slayers is torn apart and he must make a decision.
Will he allow his Class to be purged from his soul, or will he cling to it, abandon all that he knows, and rise to power?
chased-by-my-billionaire-ex-husband:
Claire Reed thought she married the man of her dreams, Evander Kensington, but she had no idea that their marriage was built on a lie; a family vow that trapped him by her side.
His heart, however, belonged to another woman, his white lotus.
No matter how hard Claire tried to win Evander’s love, he only grew colder, and his family treated her like she didn’t exist.
When she lost their unborn child, Claire’s world shattered. She wanted to see Evander, but he didn't bother to check on her. Instead, he went to meet that white lotus.
Unable to bear the betrayal, she decided to free Evander from this marriage, leaving behind a letter and divorce papers, claiming she now had someone else she loved!
~~~~
“You’re mine, and I’ll never let you go!” he declared, his voice dark with possessiveness.
“But I don’t want you anymore! You can have Susan—I’m now in love with someone else!” Claire shot back, her words sharp and final.
“You can't be with anyone. Do you even know how sleepless nights I've without you?” Evander's hold on her tightened. “I'll see how you become some else when I'll claim you,” he pronounced before crashing his lips on her.
comrade-almost-a-cat-astrophic-love-stor: The person that Pei Zhen hates most in his life is the perfect Fu Sichen. Alas, life is full of surprises and unpredictability. One fine day, an accident turns Pei Zhen into Fu Sichen’s pet cat! Trapped in his cat body, Pei Zhen moves from one adventure into another while trying hard to find a way of turning back into his human self. When he finally does, the world as he once knew, has become a completely different place!

Sarah entered almost immediately and sent Ava a teasing and wicked smile.
“Really? That bad? Lucas is really great in matters of the bedroom. Did you do something wrong?”

“Oh God. That is not the kind of man you want to lose your virginity with,” Lily said.
Sarah burst into laughter at Lily's comment.
“It's not funny,” Ava scowled.
“Actually it is. Better warm up to the idea because when Alpha Lucas Raventhorn wants to take you, he will in the roughest way possible.” Sarah advised.
“You mean like last night? I thought he was going to rip you in half.” Ava rolled her eyes.
“I like my men rough.”
“Well, I don't.” Ava retorted.
“If you are looking for flowers, love, and vanilla sex. You are a concubine to the wrong alpha.”
“Ain't that the truth.” Ava murmured under her breath
demon-hunter:

When you lose the chains of desire, it means that you no longer have a road to go forward. You can only turn left, or face right.

divine-ascension-reborn-as-a-god-of-powe:
A person died in our world. And when he opened his eyes again… the stars had changed.
Reborn into the age of myth, long before his time and when Olympus stood tall, he awakens in the Garden of the Hesperides. Reincarnated as the God of Power he is now watched over by mysterious nymphs under Hera's silent command. Unaware of the divine politics at play or the godhood now within him, he must navigate a world of titans, monsters, and primordial chaos.
But he’s not entirely alone. A mysterious System, has merged with his soul, offering quests, powers, and choices that creates and enhances powers and help him shape his path toward ascension. As the gods begin to stir and ancient forces clash for control, the new deity must find his place in a pantheon not yet formed and carve a name into legend with power, cunning, and the will to rise.
Because in this world, divinity is earned.
And only those who ascend... survive.

This story draws inspiration from Greek mythology, but takes creative liberties for the sake of narrative and worldbuilding. While many elements remain faithful to the ancient myths, others will be reimagined or altered entirely.…

horizon-bright-moon-sabre: Fu Hongxue was a cripple, born with a lame leg and subject to epileptic seizures. He was also one of the most powerful, legendary figures of the martial arts world, with a dull black saber that was second to none. His fame made him a frequent target of challengers, but whenever his saber left its sheath, only corpses would remain in its wake. One day, however, Fu Hongxue rescued someone whom he should have killed...and in doing so, set of a chain of events and a conspiracy that would rock the world.
how-hard-can-losing-money-even-be:
“So I get paid ten times more if the company loses money, and only one percent of the profit if it succeeds? That’s a no-brainer. Of course I’m going to run the company straight into the ground!”
Benny burst into laughter.
Benny shouted in excitement.
Benny was absolutely thrilled.
After all, in his position, who wouldn’t be?
Being send back 20 years into the past and was reborn with a system that pays him the more he loses than when he makes a profit.
What was easier? Building a company that made money, or destroying one until it bled losses?
Well, what if…
“Sir Benny! The city plans to build new roads through X Village! The value of the land you bought has skyrocketed!”
“Sir Benny! The gaming company you invested in just released XYZ! It’s become a massive hit! The players are even praising you online, saying you’re the first owner smart enough not to ruin the developers’ vision!”
“Sir Benny—!”
“Sir Benny!”
“Sir Benny!!”
…
Well, that “what if” quickly became reality.
And Benny could only stare blankly at the system screen as the company funds surged upward at terrifying speed… while his personal wealth remained almost completely stagnant.
“…Where did it all go wrong?”
hunter-of-the-lost-gates: A decade ago, the first dungeon gates appeared, but some vanished before they were ever conquered. hunting-for-love-for-101-times:
Ye Sichen, a well-known singer with perfect appearance, is also a father of two kids. In the outside world, he is a charming star who cares about his fans and people in need. At his home, he is a lovely father and also a considerate master. A man with his fortune and statue, what bothers him so much?
Xia Nuan, a woman who dreams to be a designer, has to accept the surrogacy invitation to save her mother’s life and pay her sister’s debt. Kind and sweet as she is, what obstacles are waiting for her in the unpredicted future? Will she be courageous enough to face all the challenges?
Accidentally, he chooses her to be the nanny of his kids. What would happen between such a worldwide celebrity and an unknown surrogate woman? Is she really the kind of person that he once believed? Just read on and find out.

i-do-for-revenge:
“Marry me,” he said, his lips curving into a cruel smirk. “Let me help you destroy them.”
I should have walked away. I should have told Axel O'Brien, billionaire and the coldest man I’ve ever met, that I wasn’t desperate enough to make a deal with the devil.
But I was.
On what was supposed to be the happiest day of my life, my fiancé didn’t just ruin me; he had the audacity to confess he had loved my sister all along, and now she was carrying his child.
He ended up marrying her instead of me, while I was left alone, broken and humiliated. And the worst part? My family let it happen. They said I was the eldest child and should learn to give in to my younger sister.
They treated me like nothing, expecting me to disappear into the shadows.
But they thought wrong.
Now, I’m standing beside a man far more dangerous than any of them. A man who doesn’t believe in love, only power. His deal is simple: become his wife, and together we’ll make them regret ever betraying me.
Except what I didn’t know was that Axel had his own twisted reasons for helping me, and I might have been his vengeance all along.…
i-just-want-to-be-a-salted-fish:
There was only one thing Shen Xuan regretted before she died—finishing the ridiculously frustrating novel The Crown Prince's Obsession.
The story followed the empire's brilliant Crown Prince, whose love for the Chancellor's youngest daughter twisted into a terrifying obsession.
He wiped out the Shen family, isolated Shen Xuan from everyone she loved, and imprisoned her in a gilded palace, believing that if she belonged to no one else, she would finally belong to him.
It was a tragic ending that left countless readers cursing the obsessive male lead.
Including Shen Xuan.
When she opened her eyes again, she discovered she had transmigrated into that very novel... as Shen Xuan herself.
The good news?
She arrived when she was only five years old.
The bad news?
The story hadn't even begun.
Determined to escape her doomed fate, Shen Xuan makes one simple life goal: stay far away from the Crown Prince, avoid every plot point, cherish her loving family, and live as the empire's most carefree salted fish.
No fighting for power.
No entering the palace.
No becoming anyone's white moonlight.
Just eating, sleeping, and enjoying life.
Unfortunately...…

Those who, with bodies honed through thousands of trials and indomitable wills, break the chains of life and pursue human limits in modern cities, are known as martial artists.

However, when he returned home, he confirmed that his power had indeed awakened... he could see weapons' status, and they could gain experience when he used them or killed monsters with them. Soon, he will come to realize that no other power is better than his!
pampered-poisonous-royal-wife:
She protects her mother and become a noble girl praised by everyone. In the process of resisting the persecution of the family, she finally finds out her lot, finds the real family members as well as her beloved.
In the previous life, grandmother intended to sell her to the moneybags Zhang. Zhang family was a fire pit. Rich man Zhang was a very old man who especially loves young girls. He insulted countless girls in these years. Her mother was tortured to death in humiliation in order to protect her. Although she escaped in the end, she was lame.
Being unaware of her lot, she was schemed to death by the big family. After her rebirth, she vowed not to be used again, but to live a different and wonderful life with her intelligence and wisdom.
She keeps the foothold by using embroidery to stand up, becomes famous by showing tea art, and gain glory step by step relying on her medical sklills... She protects her mother and become a noble girl praised by everyone. In the process of resisting the persecution of the family, she finally finds out her lot, finds the real family members as well as her beloved.
picking-up-supreme-treasures-in-the-drea:
In countless civilizations of the Primordial World, there is a widely known saying.
When each civilization descends upon the Primordial, influenced by the Primordial Law, a few Supreme Treasures containing the Law will be born, which would make the owners the most powerful in the world.
Having one Supreme Treasure is the luckiest thing one could imagine, let alone becoming the owner of two or even three Treasures.
However.
Yang Fan, with the power of dreaming the future reality, does not think so.
He states, “It's just Supreme Treasures, can't they be picked up as long as you have hands? I had a few dreams and easily picked up five pieces.”
plague-doctor:
The once-bustling and noisy streets were now filled with an eerie blanket of silence.
Hoarse and frenzied whispers lingered high above the heavens, and an indescribable ancient giant lurked in the shadows of the bottomless ocean.
A mysterious plague had outbroken, and natural disasters wrought the Earth. Global pandemic and catastrophes had the panicked masses seeking illusory shelters from the devastation, day and night.
A bloody shower poured over the land as the streaks of lightning tore across the sky, illuminating the ill-intentioned gathering of ravens above. Nevermore, nevermore, quoth the ravens.
“We can see that this malformed creature has twelve pairs of ribs like humans, but also has a “transverse bone” that humans do not possess…”
In the medical school, Gu Jun continued bringing down his scalpel, illustrating the abnormal thoracic structure of the malformed cadaver on the dissection table to the surrounding students.
Ominous and treacherous times had descended! Truth and logic had crumbled, order warped into a frenzy. Humanity can only forge ahead through the power of intelligence and wisdom.
please-stop-summoning-me:
Eerie prayers were heard, and each name was distinct.
“Lord of the Ashes”
“Colorless City”
“Mist of the White Shore”
“Spirit of the Ancient”
” Dream of the Void”
“Ruler of the Chaos”
After Shen Yi transmigrated to a new world, mysterious groups seemed to be wanting to Summon him nonstop. The church, wizards, investigators, saints…
Every summoning group had something they desired. And at the same time, they offered various sacrifices.
Shen Yi was overwhelmed with annoyance, but there was nothing he could do to put a stop to it.
Eventually, he was successfully summoned by cultists.
And the first problem Shen Yi had to face was… A sacrificial little girl, who had slumped on the altar!
practicing-medical-skills-in-a-small-cli:
In a clinic on the brink of bankruptcy, Li Jingsheng, the owner of it, refused the 508th instance of overtreatment and awakened a system.
After curing a small cold, his surgical level increased significantly.
In this small clinic, a great doctor to be coveted by major hospitals is quietly being cultivated.
“You really don't need an IV for this condition; overusing antibiotics can greatly harm the body. Trust me and just take the medicine.”
“Oh, no wonder no one comes to your clinic! Turns out you can't even do an IV! Forget it, I'll go to Quick Recovery Clinic instead! If it weren't so crowded there, with IVs queued up to number 37, I'd have been treated there. I always went there for treatment, and they'd hang two bottles for me, and the medical skills are excellent. Young doctor, find a chance to learn from Doctor Zhao!”
“You've successfully refused the 508th instance of over-medication; immense merit, system loading...”
reaching-the-age-of-thirty-my-income-ran:
By the time I reached thirty, I hadn't managed to provide any of the happiness I wanted for my wife.
I also still couldn't become the support my parents relied on.
At this turning point in my fate, my income suddenly began to increase randomly.
(A daily life tale in a wealthy family setting, featuring a single female lead and no harem.)
seeking-immortality-in-the-world-of-cult:
Transmigrated to the Cultivation World.
Initially, I thought I would have to fight those fierce cultivators to the death, struggling for the slim chance of obtaining immortality.
Unexpectedly, I came equipped with an endless-lifespan panel.
What should I do now that I've suddenly become ageless?
“Countless living beings fight each other to the death in order to become immortal.”
“That's because their lifespans are limited, if they don't fight, they'll die!”
“But I'm different.”
“If I go and fight, that's when I'll really die.”
“As long as I can endure and slowly cultivate, one day I'll become an immortal.”
This is a story of an everlasting being who endures his way to immortality in the Cultivation World.
she-professed-herself-the-pupil-of-the-w:
Sakimori Kagami plays a VRMMORPG called Ark Earth Online. He is a veteran player with the name and appearance similar to an elderly bearded wizard from a certain book about a ring.
One day he purchases an appearance change item as a last resort to spend expiring currency and gets the idea of choosing what he would want to look like if his character was ever a girl.
Falling asleep should have suspended the game, but Kagami wakes up still online and feels the game has gotten a bit more realistic. Did Ark Earth Online finally get a long-awaited update? Or…
side-character-who-became-the-pseudo-pro:
[The Protagonist has been killed.]
I woke up as Nolan Midgard, a prominent side character in my favorite game, but one that is quickly discarded by the players.
In the original story, Nolan was supposed to survive quietly in the background while the protagonist solved everything.
But with the real protagonist gone, the main route collapsed.
[Compatible character found.]
[You have been granted the Pseudo-Player System.]
I never wanted to steal the protagonist's chances or save the world at all.
But if the story needed a replacement protagonist that badly…
Couldn't it have picked someone else?!
sss-cultivation-i-can-conquer-earths-ran:
Taking a quick peek into life on normal planet earth, a vicious alien race called the Xollante attacked the planet with their nuclear weapon. But that's not the story...
Shortly before the alien attack, the story was based on an orphan boy named Leo Rayden who somehow discovered that he possessed interstellar communication ability. With this ability, he communicated with a being from a planet friendly with Earth. The being told him that he must warn earthlings of the attack from the Xollante race. But Leo saw himself too young and too weak to carry out this assignment. So, neglecting the warning, the Xollante finally arrived on Earth's atmosphere and just like that, Northern Earth became destroyed... The Space Guardians of Earth couldn't stand the almighty Xollante fleet.
And to make matters worse, Earth's core became weak and split.
But that is still not the story...
A second era now was set in place after the nuclear attack. Earth became split from the core after the nuclear attack and slowly, the Northern and the Southern part of earth started drifting apart. The wild Xollante race occupied the North, while the surviving earthlings occupied the South.…
supreme-arch-magus:
Kent is an ordinary wizard in the Sky family wizard school, and his wife Thea also works as an elder in the same school. As Thea is moving out to the elder barracks, she kicks Kent out of the house and puts the house for sale.
“You are just a piece of waste who couldn’t earn a silver.” Thea’s last words still lingering in Kent’s soul. (It’s not like Kent is a lazy guy who escapes studies. Most of Kent’s meridians were locked down by a curse.)
Suddenly on the same day, Kent received a Raven from his maternal aunt. “Are you really my aunt?” Kent questioned with a doubtful gaze. “Yes, Kent… I have sent 5000 gold and Heavenly elixir to remove your meridian curse. Don’t mind asking me for more money. Your mom left a huge fortune for you.”
From that moment Kent’s life changed as he brought a new flying pet equal to core disciples, new weapons, Villas, Fancy meals, and whatnot. Soon, his powers sore and he became a Supreme Arch Magus.
the-diary-of-a-female-zombies-hiking-adv:
When the apocalypse broke out, Yu Qingxian chose to die.
But death failed, and she became a zombie.
With social anxiety and depression in life, she chose to go on a walking tour.
Since she was a zombie anyway, she seemed to have lost her fears.
the-dragons-harem:
The mighty void dragons are on the brink of extinction due to a strange condition. Their bodies have suddenly started rejecting their kind.
Due to that, Arad's mother dropped his egg into a forest where he could hatch safely, leaving him with a fragment of her consciousness and informing him of the condition of their race.
From that point, his goal became clear. To save their race by either mating a lot or finding a cure for their condition.
But, sadly, nothing is ever that easy. Arad is still practically a newborn and cannot tap into the terrifying might of his race, and his rarity makes him a prime target for mages and scholars seeking to study the dying race.
the-evil-prince-and-his-precious-wife-th:
A story of time-travel. Sly and cunning, she unexpectedly became a sickly noble lady whose fiancé is merciless and demotes her to a lowly concubine. She sneers and bravely breaks off the engagement. To hell with scumbags, marry heirs to lords, blind the courts with her brilliance.
But, my Lord, we agreed that we are only partnering to scheme against others, when did you start to treat acting as real? Hey, hey, don’t touch me.
The Lord smiled slyly, “Your hands are too cold, let me help you warm them... Your feet are cold too, let me help you warm them.”
“Why don’t you just say that my whole body is cold and you need to warm it all up”, Murong Xue said indignantly.
The Lord nodded, “Good idea!”
Murong Xue – speechless. Hey hey hey, where, where are you putting your hands?
the-frugal-mage:
The Coinbound System lets him buy spells, skills, and stat boosts like a magical vending machine...
But nothing comes free.
Every fireball costs gold.
Every body enhancement? Taxed.
Even getting a suggestion comes with a convenience fee.
While nobles train for years to master a single flame spell, he can just buy it off the System. From summoning spirit beasts to crafting forbidden runes, his power grows with every coin he scrapes together… and every unnecessary expense he dodges.
But in a world where magic is passed down through noble bloodlines and ancient family grimoires, a broke outsider with a price tag on every spell has no business rising through the ranks.
Still, he’s surviving. Thriving, even.
So long as he tracks every copper and refuses to overspend on fireballs, he just might make it out alive.
They call him cheap.
They call him stingy.
But one day… they’ll all remember the name:
The Frugal Mage.
the-heiress-acts-mischievously-but-her-f:
After switching bodies, Jiang Nan Shu becomes the villainous true daughter in a melodramatic tale and is bound to an all-encompassing revulsion system. If everyone's level of disgust for her reaches 100, she can return to her original world with a prize of ten billion. Being reckless is just one of her many skills. Starting with a disgust level of 89, Jiang Nan Shu sets a modest goal for herself: to live a life collecting easy money within six months. Unbeknownst to her, everyone can hear her inner thoughts!
When facing the domineering CEO eldest brother, she says outwardly, “I think this project is excellent and will make a fortune.” Inwardly she thinks, “I hope you don’t go bankrupt! Once you're out, I'll steal your company's secrets.”
When dealing with the indifferent medical second brother: outwardly, “The food at your colleagues' gathering looks so appetizing.” Inwardly she thinks, “I'll switch tables when the second brother picks food, to avoid catching any diseases from him.”
When facing the sickly research third brother, she says outwardly, “Third brother, you're amazing to conduct such tough experiments, keep going.…
the-lustful-villain-every-milfs-and-gilf:
[WARNING: MATURE CONTENT R18]
[SMUTS]
Rex Rexilion was a scumbag piece of shit—and he knew it.
He was a bully. A serial heartbreaker. A man who laughed at consequences and crushed others for fun.
When death finally claimed him, Rex expected hell. Instead, he woke up in another world.
A cruel, lawless fantasy realm where heroes are hypocrites, gods are bored, and morality is just another currency.
Before Rex could even process his reincarnation, a sarcastic system appeared before his eyes with a mocking, smug, and disturbingly honest personality.
[Desire Authority System Activated.]
[Objective: Harvest desire from all womens you can get.]
The rules were simple and ridiculous: the deeper the desire of MILFs, GILFs, queens, widows, and forgotten legends, the stronger Rex would become.
All of his strength, skills, titles, even fate itself would bend to him as long as he continued indulging in temptation.
To Rex, it sounded less like a curse and more like a joke.
A joke he was very willing to play along with.…
the-nameless-extra-i-proofread-this-worl:
Yuzuki thought it was just another pastime from his casework, proofreading a half-finished fantasy webnovel. But when he woke up the next day, he was no longer in his world. He was inside the story… as a disposable extra.
The world he now walks is beautiful, brutal, and broken. Its plot is incomplete. And looming over it all is a calamity so catastrophic that even the protagonist would have failed to stop it. Driven only by his cunning and spite towards this twisted fate, his only choice is to stake his existence in a world on the verge of collapse. But how long can a nameless extra outwit the fate of an unfinished novel? How is he going to survive in this ruined world?
If the story dies, so does he.
“Well, curse the protagonist. Why would I gamble my life on some self-righteous fool who’s just doomed to fall anyway?”
#Academy
#WeakToStrongMC
No Harem!
the-sage-who-transcended-samsara: Throughout this current life of mine, I will pay no attention to my past lives, nor will I seek future lives. I wish to live vigorously, to pay back debt of gratitude and fulfill duty to avenge, to defeat valiant heroes from all species, and to proudly laugh at all the Gods and Demons of the Six Path of Reincarnation!
the-soldier-king-becomes-a-useless-littl:
The female soldier king traverses into a useless little girl, confronting the strongest ghost lord who is both salty and sweet.
She is the first legendary female soldier king in history, who traversed and was actually sold by a scumbag!!
Unable to cultivate, abandoned, and cursed for a hundred lives, without a good ending?
She holds a book defying fate, enslaving the heavens, making the earth her servant. Whoever splashes dirty water on her, she boils it and splashes it back.
Punching scumbags, kicking white lotuses, with the universe in her left hand and the world in her right, she counterattacks in one fell swoop, changing the winds and clouds.
Behind her, a lazy voice calls out.
“Stop right there. I've confirmed through the eyes, you are the woman this lord wants to flirt with.”
the-speedrun-manual-of-miss-witch:
In her third year living in this steampunk world, Ciel gained the ability to simulate both the past and the future.
These simulations turned into a game where she could act without restraint, and after countless trials, real life became a replica she could navigate as though speedrunning it.
Churches, potions, mutations, the Old Gods, witches, sealed artifacts… none of these have anything to do with Ciel. She’s just an ordinary girl who wishes for a peaceful life.
She just happens to be particularly skilled at snuffing out danger before it even begins.
the-sword-dynasty: After annihilating Han, Zhao and Wei empires in succession, the dynasty of Qin is ushering in an unprecedented flourishing age with powerful cultivators emerging endlessly. People take pride in being part of the Qin dynasty. However, Ding Ning, a young lad of humble origin in Changling, Qin, is determined to subvert this dynasty and kill the emperor who breaks in the Eighth Realm.
three-eight:
※ This book contains coercive relationships and violent scenes. Please be aware before proceeding.
※ The names, locations, and characters mentioned in this book are entirely fictional.
The calculation method of gamblers is truly peculiar.
They lend money at exorbitant interest rates to those who haven’t even spent any money as collateral.
For 15 years, Hongju has been collecting debts from housemates while being tied to collateral.
One day, a man appears, claiming he will invest in the house.
A rich fool, a money tree.
The housemates called him Mookyung.
“As long as you do as I say, I’ll help you.”
Mookyung makes a suspicious proposal, offering to repay the debts in exchange for house information.
Why would he make such a proposal to a debtor who is already struggling?
Still, there is suspicion about him…
“Do you think I’m a swindler right now?”
“No.”
“You shouldn’t. It’s all too obvious. Swindlers can tell just by looking.”
Hongju has no choice but to accept that proposal.
Growing up on scraps, he knows exactly where to stretch his legs.
trait-hoarder:
In the mobile game Arcane Seoul.
The day after I pulled the SSR Heavenly Demon for the first time…
I ended up becoming the N-rank character, Warrior Kim.
[2023 Grand Prize at the World’s Largest Web Novel Contest]
transmigrated-into-werewolf-novel-im-a-v:
Note: This is not your typical werewolf story. It's an absurd comedy. Leave your expectations for angst, drama, and seriousness at the door~
Azura devours stories of fake daughters, hidden heiresses, and satisfying divorces like a fine wine, but there's one genre she can't stand: werewolf romances.
Alphas, fated mates, moon goddesses? It's a cheesy mess she actively avoids.
So, of course, that's exactly where fate decides to dump her.
After a conveniently 'tragic' accident, Azura wakes up in the body of a villainess—her own namesake, no less—in the very werewolf novel she once scorned. Her knowledge of the plot is embarrassingly sparse, limited to the erotic chapters she’d skimmed for curiosity's sake. Undeterred, she formulates a simple plan: befriend the heroine she’s destined to torment and secure a peaceful ending.
The result? She accidentally traumatizes the poor girl even more.
To make matters catastrophically worse, she doesn't just tangle with one male lead. She snags all four of them. And after a chaotic kidnapping and a night of... complicated events, she finds herself pregnant with their babies.…
upgraded-rise-of-the-cyberkid:
Dexter a teenager that always gets bullied by others at school was involved in a incident which required him to get a chip in his brain.
Thanks to the help of the chip he had become smarter than the average human, leading to lots of new inventions and discoveries, and gains the ability to move through dimensions but as always there is a down side as humans get invaded by aliens in search of him.
vampire-summoners-rebirth-summoning-the-:
After an ultimate battle against the King of Hell Lucifer, Asmodeus, the Vampire Emperor, has fallen. Although he lost, he died without regrets and with a smile, prideful that he had managed to corner the King of Hell himself to such an extent.
However, due to a sick twist of fate, Lucifer himself decided to reincarnate him into the feeble body of a human child named Blake, desiring a rematch in the future!
Now, given a new opportunity at life, Blake will use every possible way to grow stronger and protect his new family in a turbulent world where people can summon spirits to fight and develop their magical powers.
Armed with only a Grimoire, he’ll slowly summon all of his previous life subordinates, who are all powerful Vampires, and rise to the top while fighting the ever-growing menace of the Demon Towers.
Accompany Blake through a journey filled with excitement and growth and experience the rise of the Vampire Emperor. A new Era of Blood is about to begin.
your-spell-version-is-too-low:
Qi Yun suddenly transmigrated, finding himself as a bottom-tier reserve disciple of a Demonic Sect.
Fortunately, his “Golden Finger” awakened—all of his spells began to automatically update themselves!
[Spell auto-update complete. This is a minor version patch. Spell effects have been adjusted as follows…]
[Basic Sword Qi v2.0]: Power increased by 50%.
[Basic Sword Qi v3.0]: Quantity of Sword Qi +1.
[Basic Sword Qi v4.0]: Casting range expanded. ……
Years later, when an army of countless Righteous Path cultivators besieged his mountain, Qi Yun merely smiled faintly. With a simple point of his finger, a resplendent sword beam—blazing like a massive sun and radiating an oppressive might that crushed everything in its path—tore through the firmament!
The enemy horde stared in dumbfounded shock: “This is… Basic Sword Qi?!”
Qi Yun slowly nodded. “Indeed. It’s just that mine is on Version 50.0.”
